eps.d: Father Clifford arrives in Ballykissangel and arouses much interest, especially as he left his old parish unexpectedly.

eps.t: The Things We Do for Love
eps.d: Father Clifford arranges a football match, but the visit of young woman causes comment and embarrassment.

eps.t: Live in My Heart and Pay No Rent
eps.d: Father Clifford tries to encourage reluctant groom Ambrose to marry his bride Meanwhile Quigley is on the mountain waiting for his lost love.
Father Clifford meets his match in a cantankerous old atheist. Assumpta helps Father Clifford pass his driving test, and Egan tries to close Angel FM.
Quigley is standing in the by-election, but a visiting reporter has some dirt on him. Liam and Donal find a 50-year-old skeleton.
Father Clifford learns he's to be sent back to England and finds that nobody will miss him, not even Assumpta.
Sparks fly when Father Clifford casts Assumpta as heroine in the village play. She objects to playing the love scenes, but then the romantic lead arrives.
When Enda is spotted panning for gold, Liam and Donal cook up a tourism scam. Meanwhile Father Clifford tries to save the job of a dedicated teacher.
Father Clifford has a problem getting young people into church. Hollywood comes to town in the form of Quigley and his video camera.
When a new-born baby is left on Father Clifford's doorstep, he sets out to find the mother. Meanwhile, a new very strict Garda arrives in town.
Brian Quigley hires a new housekeeper despite Niamh's displeasure. A bunch of tearaway kids cause problems for schoolteacher Brendan.
Brian Quigley announces a beauty contest just as the beautiful Naomi comes to town claiming to be Eamonn's niece. Niamh and Father Clifford are having trouble with Con O'Neil.
Kathleen's house is badly damaged by fire but she has no insurance. A collection is started involving a flutter on dogs where Brian Quigley is hoping to win.
The presence of two strangers in town causes consternation for those with something to hide. Father Clifford struggles to control his feelings when he hears Assumpta may leave.
A small statue in the chapel starts sweating, but Father Clifford is suspicious of the miracle. Niamh is calm about her impending baby, but Ambrose is terrified.
The village is fiercely divided over Quigley's latest plans. Father Clifford tries not to take sides until Assumpta puts him on the spot.
Quigley is about to pull off the deal of his life, but first he has to impress a group of Korean businessmen with some Irish nostalgia.
Ambrose's mother Imelda returns to look after baby Kieran. Quigley takes an unusual interest in her, much to Ambrose's dismay.

eps.t: I Know When I'm Not Wanted
eps.d: Father Peter Clifford is thrown into organising a pub quiz. He and the village are stunned when Assumpta returns from Dublin with some big news.
Assumpta decides to become more assertive but as Kathleen points out, she needs to sort out her own life before telling people what to do.
The appearance of a young stranger unsettles some of the older residents of the village. Siobhain gets some surprising news.
Lottery fever takes hold in Ballykissangel. Ambrose is sent on an undercover mission that could be the making of him.
Padraig receives a visit from his ex-wife and faces up to prospect of losing custody of his son. Meanwhile the villagers join forces when Quigley starts up his latest venture.
Father Clifford finally decides to tell Assumpta of his true feelings for her - but what will she think?
Peter has to make some important decisions about where his future lies. Despite it being a difficult time, Quigley carries on with his business ventures.
As Fitzgerald's bar is up for auction, a number of new faces arrive in Ballykissangel, some more welcome than others.
Father Aidan, Ballykissangel's new priest, has a spectacularly successful first day, which proves to be a headache for Father Mac.
Brendan is appalled by Siobhan's plans for a water birth. Father Aidan and his sister settle in the town, but find themselves plagued by money worries.
Brian Quigley's dreams of owning a golf course get a boost, while Siobhan and Brendan disagree on their daughter's christening.
There is much curiosity over the new love in Donal's life, but Suzie proves to be a wild and dangerous female.
The villagers are all at the beach for the annual horse race, usually won by Doctor Ryan. However, this year there is stiff competition from a mystery horse owned by Eamon.
It's the grand opening of Quigley's golf course, and with assistants like Liam and Donal, the event is sure to go with a bang.
A bizarre, ancient statue is uncovered at Dillon's farm which seems to have a strange effect on people.
Father Mac is visited by an old friend and former curate, now a high flying bishop with a problem. Danny and Emma are stranded by heavy rain.
Brendan and Siobhan finally decide to tie the knot - but keeping it a secret could be a problem. Niamh and Ambrose, meanwhile, worry about the state of their marriage.
Niamh leaves Ambrose holding the baby, and Kathleen gets an unexpected visitor. Donal and Liam try to earn some extra cash.
There are some strange goings on in the stratosphere over Ballykissangel. Niamh faces her feelings for Sean.

eps.t: Two Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
eps.d: Has Quigley got what it takes to save the village's reputation, and will Orla be rescued from the runaway hot air balloon?
The village mourn the loss of Ambrose, who is laid to rest. Orla is looking for somewhere to live and Conor Devlin is a potential landlord.
While sand and mud create earthy problems around the village, Niamh takes a radical decision to solve a problem of her own.
Emma has had enough of her father's strange behaviour towards Niamh, but what will Ballykissangel's gossips think of her moving in with Danny?
The lure of a goldmine leads Quigley into a race against time. He isn't the only one who believes they've struck gold, when a little help from Orla goes a long way with Conor.
Quigley bids farewell to Niamh and discovers the new owner of the pub is an old enemy. Conor's amorous intentions are foiled by Orla.
When the headmaster's job becomes available, Brendan feels it's time to improve himself, but faces some stiff competition.
Dooley and Minto have a dangerous new business deal and arrange a supply of illicit liquor, but with the new Garda arriving in town, are they really away from prying eyes?
Orla gives Conor the elbow while Frankie finds her own brand of justice for Dooley. Out in the field Liam and Donal are seeing things larger than life in a hedge.

eps.t: With a Song in My Heart
eps.d: Dillon finds his decision to see Niamh in Dublin has a much bigger impact than he expected. Aidan's plans for the choir aren't going well.
When Frankie and Aidan join forces for a day out, Aidan's reputation as a priest is compromised. Liam and Donal are the first to hear a big announcement from Niamh and Sean.
Minto seizes his chance to give Dillon an unforgettable stag party, while a close encounter makes Niamh and Dillon's wedding day more memorable than expected.
Vincent Sheahan, the new Australian priest, arrives and has to play detective when an online confessional gets out of control.
Frankie stops Father Vincent Sheahan for drink driving. Meanwhile Paul has his eye on Louis' run down shack.
Father Sheahan hears an interesting confession. Grainne's pet goat suddenly becomes indispensable after meeting Avril's horse.
The ghost of a highwayman returns to haunt the village, after Dooley finds some ancient fishing rights. Kathleen causes havoc as she learns to drive.

eps.t: Paul Dooley Sleeps with the Fishes
eps.d: When Avril's ex-husband arrives in town, Vincent fights to provide her some solace. Paul is running out of time to repay a debt to Liam and Donal.
Vincent oversees this year's parish fete. Donal and Liam prepare for the cow in the field competition and Oonagh aims to win prizes for her jam.
Vincent needs a leap of faith if he is to be true to his best friend. The arrival of a faith-healer and a truculent Father Mac add to his problems.
Vincent is disciplined for marrying Lyn and Barry. Frankie finds out Doc Ryan has prescribed cannabis plants for her aunt.
